mapper.select: select * from sales_service where status = 'ACTIVE' order by createdat desc
mapper.insert: insert into sales_service ( serviceid, servicename, empnum, memnum, basecount, actualcount, discount, baseamount, actualamount, servicetype, refundid, status, createdat, updatedat ) values ( #{serviceId}, #{serviceName}, #{empNum}, #{memNum}, #{baseCount}, #{actualCount}, #{discount}, #{baseAmount}, #{actualAmount}, #{serviceType}, null, 'ACTIVE', now(), now() )
mapper.update: update sales_service set refundid = #{refundId}, updatedat = now() where servicesalesid = #{serviceSalesId} and status = 'ACTIVE'

update sales_service set empnum = #{empNum}, servicename = #{serviceName}, basecount = #{baseCount}, actualcount = #{actualCount}, discount = #{discount}, baseamount = #{baseAmount}, actualamount = #{actualAmount}, updatedat = now() where servicesalesid = #{serviceSalesId} and status = 'ACTIVE'
update sales_service set status = 'DELETED', updatedat = now() where servicesalesid = #{serviceSalesId} and status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.select: select count(1) from sales_service ss join employee e on ss.empnum = e.empnum

select ss.servicesalesid as "servicesalesid", ss.serviceid as "serviceid", ss.servicename as "servicename", ss.servicetype as "servicetype", ss.empnum as "empnum", e.empname as "empname", ss.memnum as "memnum", m.memname as "memname", ss.basecount as "basecount", ss.actualcount as "actualcount", ss.discount as "discount", ss.baseamount as "baseamount", ss.actualamount as "actualamount", ss.status as "status", ss.createdat as "createdat", ss.updatedat as "updatedat" from sales_service ss left join employee e on ss.empnum = e.empnum left join member m on ss.memnum = m.memnum
order by ss.createdat desc, ss.servicesalesid desc limit (#{endRow}-#{startRow}+1) offset #{startRow}-1
